data.name: Rayyis
data.gender_notes: Rayyis is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who advises, gives counsel, or manages affairs. Derived from the verb 'rayyasa', meaning 'to advise' or 'to manage'. The name Rayyis carries the meaning “Advisor, Counselor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rayyis usually hope their child will grow to embody advisor, counselor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting a deep connection to wisdom and knowledge, as well as a strong sense of responsibility and duty.
data.etymology: Rayyis belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Advisor, Counselor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayyis total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رئيس
in_arabic.meaning: الرئيس يعني القائد أو السيد في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرئيس هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ويعني القائد أو السيد، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ' (النبأ: 83)، وقد استخدم العرب هذا الاسم للدلالة على الشخص الذي يتولى قيادة مجموعة أو مجتمع، ويحمل هذا الاسم دلالات روحية واجتماعية مهمة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: رئيس
in_urdu.meaning: رئيس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے قائد یا سردار
in_urdu.long_meaning: رئيس ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے قائد یا سردار، یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ' (النبأ: 83)، اور یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے، خصوصاً جنوبی ایشیاء میں جہاں اردو زبان بولی جاتی ہے.

in_hindi.name: रईस
in_hindi.meaning: रईस का अर्थ होता है नेता या सरदार
in_hindi.long_meaning: रईस एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से निकला है, और इसका अर्थ होता है नेता या सरदार, यह नाम कुरआन में भी उल्लेखित है, जैसे कि 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ' (النبأ: 83), और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक महत्वपूर्ण स्थान रखता है.

in_pashto.name: رئيس
in_pashto.meaning: رئيس د قوم یا ډلې مشر معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: رئيس یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او معنی یې د قوم یا ډلې مشر دی، دا نوم د قران کریم په کښی هم ذکر شوی دی، لکه 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ' (النبأ: 83)، او دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې مهم ځای لري.

in_english.name: Rayyis
in_english.meaning: Rayyis means leader, chief, or president in English
in_english.long_meaning: Rayyis is a masculine given name originating from Arabic, meaning leader, chief, or president. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ء-س' (r-'-s), it signifies authority and leadership. The name has been mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing its importance in Islamic tradition. Rayyis symbolizes guidance, wisdom, and the ability to lead, making it a significant name in Muslim cultures worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: In various Islamic societies, the role of a Rayyis holds significant importance due to the wisdom and knowledge they possess. They are often consulted for advice on personal matters, professional decisions, and communal issues. A Rayyis is a figure of trust, credibility and expertise. In some contexts, the term Rayyis is used interchangeably with the title of a Shari'ah Scholar or a Mufti. Additionally, Rayyis is also used to refer to a person who manages an Islamic institution or a large business enterprise.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, a Rayyis embodies the virtues of knowledge, wisdom and guidance. In the Holy Quran, Allah (SWT) says, "And We sent not before you (O Muhammad SAW) any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke, the people said: 'Indeed, a great knowledge has been given to him.' " (Al-Anbiya', 3:113). This acknowledgement of the prophets' great knowledge is a testament to the significance of knowledge and advice in the Islamic tradition. A Rayyis, through their pursuit of knowledge and implementation of wisdom, acts as a reminder of the blessings of knowledge and the importance of seeking and following good counsel. Their role is not only limited to giving advice but extends to the practical guidance in people's lives. By fulfilling this role as a respected advisor, a Rayyis can instill a sense of confidence, direction and reassurance in the hearts of those who seek their counsel.
